cases: Unchanged fixed Hard6 identities, arm order, model, provider, seed, image, goal, evaluator, and broad safety limits.
only_method_interface_change: Incremental runners receive the same fresh-replay path-portability instruction already present for whole-program runners.
analysis_priority: Success before resource use; deployment quality remains separate.

execution.pair_host_rule: Both arms of each pair execute on the same host and lane.
execution.host_interpretation: Host is blocked by pair; no cross-pair host difference is interpreted as a method effect.

pilot_use: The terminated pilot is diagnostic mechanism evidence only and is excluded from effect estimates.
